correctness.rationale: An exact six-coordinate quadratic expansion gives the necessity of both parts of the iff condition; explicit roots prove sufficiency in all algebraic cases; a disjoint count proves the image polynomial for every q=2^e. The paired nilpotent examples have equal Jordan type and opposite fixed-flag square status. Exhaustive target-by-target checks at q=2 and q=4 confirm but do not certify the general theorem.

value.rationale: The exact image of a power-word map in a natural finite p-group, at the first non-surjective dimension, is a motivated inverse-word problem. The complete membership criterion resolves every target and gives a uniform polynomial for every finite extension field, rather than merely repeating the two already tabulated values. Same-Jordan-type matrices behaving differently isolates an intrinsic fixed-flag obstruction.
